original_source: [Abnormal Fault – Recovered] Cross-region access anomaly between Mainland China and certain overseas regions
symptoms: intermittent connectivity between Mainland China and overseas regions
failure_pattern: An ISP routing fault caused abnormal routing paths between Mainland China and overseas regions, leading to cross-region network access anomalies such as intermittent connectivity. The issue was detected by Alibaba Cloud monitoring and resolved within an hour.
mitigation_principle: Implement multi-ISP redundancy; monitor cross-region connectivity proactively; establish SLAs with ISPs; use automated failover; perform regular network path verification

failure_pattern: An issue within China Unicom's local DNS infrastructure caused DNS resolution failures, leading to service disruptions for users relying on those DNS records. The anomaly was detected by Alibaba Cloud monitoring and resolved after emergency handling.
mitigation_principle: Implement redundant DNS resolvers; monitor DNS health proactively; establish SLAs with ISP for DNS reliability; automate failover to alternative DNS providers

original_source: [Exception (recovered)]Abnormalities in purchase and modify for certain products in Shanghai region
symptoms: purchase failures for ECS and EIP
modify failures for ECS and EIP
failure_pattern: A misconfiguration in the VPC private network caused the purchase and modify APIs for ECS and EIP to fail, leading to errors for users attempting to create or modify resources. Existing instances remained unaffected because the issue only impacted provisioning services.
mitigation_principle: implement automated validation of VPC network configurations; establish monitoring for provisioning API errors; perform regression testing on network changes; use canary deployments for network changes

original_source: [Exception (Resolved)] Some CDN Service Nodes Are Experiencing abnormal
symptoms: service disruptions in Video Live Streaming
service disruptions in Video On Demand
failure_pattern: Abnormal behavior in CDN service nodes caused disruptions across multiple services that rely on CDN, leading to anomalies in Video Live Streaming, Video On Demand, CDN, and DCDN. The affected nodes were taken offline, and services were gradually recovered.
mitigation_principle: implement health checks and automated failover for CDN nodes; monitor node health metrics; isolate node failures to prevent cascading; apply redundancy and load balancing; perform regular hardware diagnostics; enable rapid rollback and incident response

original_source: [Incident recovered] An abnormality in network access in the China (Beijing) region's mobile network
symptoms: inability to access Alibaba Cloud services
failure_pattern: The incident began when the Beijing China Mobile network experienced an outage, causing loss of connectivity to Alibaba Cloud services for users on that network. The failure propagated to all services accessed via that ISP, resulting in service unavailability until the ISP restored connectivity.
mitigation_principle: Implement multi-ISP routing; add redundant network paths; monitor external network health; provide clear guidance for users to switch networks

original_source: [Incident Report] Alibaba Cloud Service Disruption - June 27, 2018
symptoms: unable to access Alibaba Cloud console
service outages for MQ, NAS, and OSS
failure_pattern: During routine maintenance, a new automated-OSS feature was deployed. A latent code bug caused the feature to incorrectly blacklist a subset of internal IP addresses, breaking the data path for several services. This resulted in customers being unable to access the Alibaba Cloud console and key services such as MQ, NAS, and OSS.
mitigation_principle: Implement automated deployment safeguards; improve release validation procedures; enforce rigorous code review and testing

original_source: Abnormal access to Huawei Cloud for Beijing Mobile operator users
failure_pattern: A misconfiguration in the routing tables of the Huawei Cloud network caused certain domains to be incorrectly routed for Beijing Mobile operator users. This resulted in abnormal access to those domains, leading to a disruption of network services in the cn-north-4 region.
mitigation_principle: implement automated routing validation checks; enforce strict change management for routing configurations; monitor domain access patterns in real-time; conduct regular network topology reviews

original_source: Network anomaly on port 443 between China's three major telecom operators and Huawei Cloud's overseas nodes
failure_pattern: An unknown routing or connectivity issue between China's major telecom operators and Huawei Cloud overseas nodes caused a disruption on port 443, leading to HTTPS traffic failures for services in the China-Hong Kong region.
mitigation_principle: implement redundant network paths; monitor cross-border connectivity proactively; establish fallback protocols; maintain clear communication channels with operators

original_source: Timeout exception when accessing domain names via CDN service in Beijing 1 node
symptoms: access abnormalities for some domain names
failure_pattern: The CDN's DNS resolver cluster reached capacity, causing timeouts for domain name resolution. This led to intermittent failures for affected domain names, resulting in access abnormalities for users and disruption of related cloud services.
mitigation_principle: proactive capacity monitoring; automated scaling of DNS resolver clusters; health checks and alerting for DNS resolution latency; redundancy and load balancing across nodes

original_source: Network-Related Issues in the Guangzhou Region (RESOLVED)
failure_pattern: Abnormal requests triggered a bug in the control plane, causing it to delete service rules for certain PaaS services. The missing rules prevented proper routing and access control, leading to service request failures and connectivity issues across multiple cloud services in the Guangzhou region.
mitigation_principle: Block abnormal request sources and standardize service invocation methods; release control plane bug fix; enhance monitoring and alerting for service rule changes; implement and drill rollback procedures for erroneous deletions

original_source: Problems with Cloud Data Warehouse etc. detected in Virginia (RESOLVED)
failure_pattern: A power failure in the Virginia AZ 1 IDC caused loss of power to network and compute equipment, leading to an abnormal network that disrupted connectivity for Cloud Virtual Machine, TDMQ, VPC, EMR, and Cloud Data Warehouse services, resulting in servers not working, databases becoming inaccessible, and console abnormalities.
mitigation_principle: implement redundant power supplies; deploy UPS and backup generators; monitor power status continuously; establish automated failover procedures; conduct regular power infrastructure testing

failure_pattern: Automated scripts intended for test nodes mistakenly included production nodes due to incorrect identification. The monitoring system then issued security interception policies to those production nodes, blocking legitimate Layer 7 traffic and causing service disruptions.
mitigation_principle: implement circuit breaker for automated verification; use manual verification for high-risk policies; optimize policy verification logic; strictly limit batch activation scope; add verification and approval steps for high-risk policies

failure_pattern: During a high-load HA master‑slave switch, the database instance was incorrectly marked as migrated and its old VIP was deactivated. This left only the new VIP reachable, causing connections to the old VIP to fail. The resulting database connection failures cascaded to the cloud monitoring console, rendering alarm and dashboard services unusable.
mitigation_principle: Verify migration completion before deactivating old IPs; enforce automated migration status checks; accelerate migration schedule; standardize database usage and monitor high‑load instances; proactively expand capacity and optimize slow queries
